question: Can a finite receiving contract certify mass conservation, total-variation contraction and accumulated perturbation bounds without confusing a stationary or periodic trace with global convergence?
level: external exact rational research; applied-mathematics priority 6

mathematics.kernel: Fixed two-state endokernel K=[[a,1-a],[b,1-b]], all entries nonnegative with each row sum one; row laws evolve p_next=p*K.
mathematics.quantifiers: For all rational probability laws p,r, TV(pK,rK)=q TV(p,r), q=abs(a-b). This also holds over real laws. All entries of the given kernel are checked, including unvisited rows.
mathematics.TV: half the sum of absolute component differences; for normalized two-state laws equals the absolute first-coordinate difference
mathematics.stationary: The caller supplies pi and receiver checks pi*K=pi. q<1 gives strict contraction; q=1 does not certify convergence or uniqueness. Swap can have unique pi without convergence.
mathematics.exact: p_0=initial; p_{k+1}=p_k K for k from 0 to horizon-1
mathematics.approximation: Every supplied approximate law h_k must itself be a probability vector. TV(h_0,p_0)<=initial_error; TV(h_{k+1},h_k K)<=step_errors[k].
mathematics.stationary_bound: S_k=q^k TV(p_0,pi)+B_k; TV(h_k,pi)<=S_k. The factor starts at 1 at k=0, even when q=0. Do not clamp B or S to 1.
mathematics.limits: Finite error allowances certify only the declared horizon. The homogeneous exact-map contraction argument is not an infinite noisy-process guarantee or identification of a physical transition law.

request.labels: question and each of exactly two distinct states have 1..80 characters; history has 1..4 such strings and is retained in order
request.rationals: canonical [integer numerator,positive integer denominator]; abs components <=64, no bool or float; kernel, initial and stationary are probability rows
request.error_and_tolerance: initial_error and tolerance lie in [0,1]; step_errors has exactly horizon rational values in [0,1]

candidate.binding: profile exact and request canonical JSON identical to independently selected expected request
candidate.trace: list of 1..horizon+1 consecutive entries beginning at 0; each exact fields index,exact,approx,error_to_exact,step_residual,propagated_bound,distance_to_stationary,stationary_bound
candidate.trace_rationals: canonical rational components and arithmetic intermediates <=512 bits; exact/approx are two-element probability vectors (not restricted to input cap64)
candidate.trace_rules: exact is p_k, approx is h_k; error_to_exact=TV(h_k,p_k); step_residual=null at k=0 and actual one-step residual otherwise; bounds are exactly the stated B_k,S_k; distance_to_stationary is actual TV(h_k,pi). Each row checks all fields and budgets before joining verified_prefix.
candidate.claim: exact fields kind,regime,steps,final_bound; regime StrictContraction if q<1 else Nonexpansive; steps=len(trace)-1; final_bound=last S. If len(trace)<horizon+1 kind UnknownCoverage, even if the current bound meets tolerance. Else CertifiedTolerance iff S_horizon<=tolerance, otherwise VerifiedHorizon.

receiver.accepted_result: null except complete valid trace and claim; then {kind,regime,steps,final_bound,actual_final_distance}
receiver.obstruction: UnknownCoverage gives {missing_indices:[len(trace)..horizon]}; all other outcomes null
receiver.retention: On later invalid evidence, retain only complete independently verified prefix entries; no accepted final result. Raw expected parse failure may give expected_request=null, exact bytes remain in evidence.
receiver.authority: native_authority, close_authorized and free_authorized always false

independence.producer: two-component row-matrix product; TV via half L1; q via maximum pairwise row TV
independence.receiver: scalar affine recurrence x_next=b+(a-b)x; scalar absolute distance after probability normalization checks
independence.point_controls: finite independent full-row arithmetic and selected analytic trajectory values; not a proof over all laws
independence.trusted: Python standard library and Fraction shared; no parent implementation import or proof-kernel artifact

budget.continuation: No automatic extension of horizon, precision, error budget, fuel or retries; retain failure before one justified correction.

controls: Strict mixing, asymmetric reuse, alternating signed deviation, identical rows q=0, horizon zero, identity, swap and already stationary starts
Identical stationary trajectories with different unused kernel rows and different global contraction factors
Initial perturbation, per-step perturbation saturating the recurrence, conservative budget larger than actual residual and unclamped bound above one
Missing future steps retain UnknownCoverage even when current tolerance is met
Refuse wrong q, mass, step, residual, initial/local budget, propagated/stationary bound, convergence regime, context and fabricated authority
Refuse malformed or nonstochastic kernel, nonstationary reference, wrong direction, horizon, error list and rational types
protected: Mass one, nonnegativity, both rows, state order, row direction, initial and stationary laws, exact horizon, all error budgets, tolerance and history
Trace error versus stationarity distance; actual residual versus declared conservative budget; partial trace versus complete horizon
An observed periodic or stationary trace is not a global convergence certificate or learned transition law
Previous distinct-space kernel composition profile remains unchanged; methodological reference, not imported parent
No native operation, Close/free/M6, universal grammar, physical energy, learned vocabulary or acceleration claim; ledger-holder-exit remains separate
